audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Akshan/Skill/Skill/Skill/Diana/Skill/Skill while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Diana/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Diana/Diana/Diana. Six of seven rows disagreed with the sentence rendered beside them.
audit.why: Diana's 900-range Q beats a level-1 Akshan with no Heroic Swing; from 2 to 5 his 850-range Avengerang and the terrain grapple kite a 20s Lunar Rush. Moonfall at 6 removes the distance he lives on, which matches the 54.2% over 1,834 games.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side = Diana, phases[1..3].side = Akshan, phases[5..6].side = Diana (phases[4] already Diana), with phases[0..3].why rewritten to match.

audit.why: Level 6 Moonfall is the flip; first item makes the combo lethal before his passive shield triggers; late he wants side-lane picks. spikes[] already reflects this. breakdown.carry was generic and was grounded onto Heroic Swing's terrain requirement.
audit.corrected: breakdown.carry and breakdown.late rewritten around denying him terrain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. First: Heroic Swing 'fires a grappling hook into terrain' and he 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain' — so in open lane, away from walls, he has no swing at all. Second: Comeuppance deals its damage 'to the first champion, minion, or structure hit', so a minion body-blocks it.
audit.why: Both come straight from Riot's text and both change where you choose to stand. The page said only 'fight while the swing is down' with no mechanism.
audit.corrected: Terrain requirement written into winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, loading, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late and dontsFull[2].d; the Comeuppance body-block written into breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions claims both Crescent Strike (Q) and Moonfall (R) reveal Akshan out of Going Rogue. Riot's Q text qualifies the reveal — it reveals enemies struck 'if they are not stealthed'.
audit.why: Per the brief's rule, Riot's description beats the derived flag. Diana's R text has no such qualifier: she 'reveals and draws in all nearby enemies'.
audit.corrected: Only the R reveal was written to the page (dosFull[2].d). No claim that Q pulls him out of Going Rogue.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing 18s->12s, Avengerang 9s->5s, Pale Cascade 15s, Comeuppance 100s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The title promised a swing-window rule and a wave-chasing rule; the bodies explained neither.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their own titles, keyed to the 18s swing and to the terrain he needs to use it.

edits.before: A dive mirror where your shield votes — trade three-hit strings behind W and out-sustain the burst exchange.
edits.after: He owns the range until you own the gap — survive the swing phase, then Moonfall makes his kiting a straight line.

edits.before: Win the shielded exchanges and flip the all-in with Moonfall. Shorthand: Heroic Swing down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Get on top of him and stay there. Heroic Swing needs terrain and 18s — fight in the open lane while it is down.

edits.before: Akshan wins by landing Heroic Swing, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Akshan wins by swinging off terrain the moment you commit, kiting your 20s Lunar Rush, and finishing with Comeuppance from 2500 range.

edits.before: - Diana vs Akshan - Track: Akshan Heroic Swing. - Dash only onto marks — the reset is the kit. - Fights start when Heroic Swing ends. - The R is for endings, not openings.
edits.after: - Diana vs Akshan - Heroic Swing is 18s and needs terrain. - Dash only onto Moonlight marks. - Fight in the open lane, away from walls. - Moonfall is for endings.

edits.before: Q the wave's edge and his face in one arc — the crescent farms and pokes at once; learn the curve's sweet spot.
edits.after: Q the wave's edge and his face in one arc at 900 range — level 1 he has no Heroic Swing to answer with.

edits.before: W shield-trade window: orbs absorb his poke and pay it back on the three-hit passive.
edits.after: Avengerang plus his double-shot passive out-ranges you, and Pale Cascade only blunts it.

edits.before: E pull joins... no — your dash threat begins: Q-mark into E reset chases are live; trade on every landed crescent.
edits.after: Heroic Swing lands at 18s — he hooks terrain, kites your Lunar Rush, and resets the trade from outside your range.

edits.before: Mark-dash trades on cooldown — Q, E to the mark, passive three-hit, walk. The lane respects the curve now.
edits.after: He kites the mark-dash: a swing off terrain beats your 20s E, so trade only while Heroic Swing is on cooldown.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Pale Cascade like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, 12s maxed and matchup-defining — it needs terrain to hook, and champion collision knocks him off it. Fight while it is down. - Avengerang runs 9s to 5s. - Pale Cascade is 15s. - Comeuppance is 100s.

edits.before: First item onward, chain the phases: mark-dash the contacts, R the river clumps, and reset through whatever groups.
edits.after: Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure it hits — stand behind your wave and it never reaches you.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by taking away distance he cannot restore — with Heroic Swing down, Akshan cannot leave a melee fight.

edits.before: You are the dive: E through the front line onto their carry, R the collapse, and let the resets carry you out famous.
edits.after: You are the dive: E onto the Moonlight mark, R the collapse, and hunt Akshan in open ground where he has no wall to hook.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: The moment Heroic Swing is spent you have 18 seconds of open lane — Q to mark, E in, three-hit string, leave.

edits.before: Akshan whiffs Heroic Swing and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Moonfall reveals and drags him in — camouflage does not save him.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Chasing him toward a wall hands him the grapple — Heroic Swing needs terrain, so break off before you reach it.

notes:
CHART: six of seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and packet.levelChart. I moved the sides onto the existing win[] values, so no paired win[N] edit was possible (before would equal after and be refused) — this closes six cross-layer disagreements rather than creating any. phases[0..3].why rewritten in the same proposal so each moved row's sentence matches its verdict; phases[4..6].why already described Diana winning. Ratings untouched.
phases[2].why on disk was garbled ('E pull joins... no —') — a template leak from another champion. Replaced.
REPORT: no report[] entry was lint-flagged and none names a fabricated ability, so per the sweep exclusion I rewrote none. report[8].t does say 'anti-heal early into his sustain', which is thin for Akshan (his only sustain is the passive shield, not healing) — flagged, not edited.
DERIVED FLAG CONFLICT: missingInteractions says Crescent Strike reveals Akshan out of Going Rogue, but Riot's Q text reveals only 'if they are not stealthed'. I wrote only the Moonfall reveal, whose text carries no such qualifier. Whether Q reveals a camouflaged target is not decidable from the kit.
UNVERIFIED, LEFT ALONE: content whys[1]/whys[2] and spikes[0].text describe Akshan using Going Rogue as a routine per-trade stealth reset in lane. Riot's W text ties camouflage to moving toward Scoundrels, and there are no Scoundrels in a normal laning phase. I could not resolve this from the kit, so I left that text untouched.
